data.name: Clinical Memory
data.detailed_description:
You wake up in Ward 7B with no name, no past, and a patient number that feels more like a warning than an identity.

At first, the hospital seems abandoned. Doors are locked, lights flicker, radios whisper through static, and something moves in the corridors. But every time you make the wrong choice, the cycle begins again. The same map returns, but something is different. Items disappear. Notes change. Triggers move. The monsters do not behave the same way.

This is not just a walking simulator. This is a memory simulator.

Explore a realistic psychological horror experience where the environment is part of the story. Use a flashlight, batteries, keys, a journal, a camera, tools, and weapons to uncover what really happened inside Ward 7B. Read notes, inspect objects, solve interaction-based puzzles, and piece together a broken chain of memories.

But be careful.

The more you remember, the less you can trust what you see.

Were you a patient?
Were you part of an experiment?
Were the monsters ever real?

Every cycle brings you closer to the final truth. And when the last choice appears, you may wish you had chosen the lie.

Add Ward 7B to your wishlist and enter a horror game where memory is the enemy.
A new horror concept: memory simulator, not just a walking simulator

  • Five distorted memory cycles with changing items, triggers, enemies, and notes

  • Realistic hospital atmosphere built around tension, sound, light, and uncertainty

  • Flashlight, battery, camera, journal, key, pistol, crowbar, and screwdriver mechanics

  • Crosshair-based interaction with doors, radios, phones, tools, weapons, puzzles, and objects

  • Modular inventory system with contextual item use

  • Story-driven notes and environmental clues that slowly change your understanding of the truth

  • Final choice system where the wrong answer sends you back into the cycle

  • A psychological twist where the monsters may not be monsters at all
